title: Equivariant Continuous Normalizing Flows with Offline Sampling for Fermionic Ground State Estimation
summary: We introduce a framework for fermionic variational Monte Carlo in which a continuous normalizing flow refines a fixed antisymmetric base wavefunction. The flow is a permutation-equivariant neural ordinary differential equation (ODE), a smooth, topology-preserving map; equivariance preserves the antisymmetry of the base, so the flow can in principle improve any antisymmetric ansatz that can be sampled efficiently.
